parameters.query:
-- W19 actions due today (SAST). One row per (cycle, action); idempotent via billing_actions_log.
with c as (
  select c.cycle_id, c.broker_id, c.tier_code, c.ends_at, coalesce(c.extended_until, c.ends_at) as effective_end, c.status, c.renewal_offer_sent_at,
         b.billing_ref, b.email, b.whatsapp_number, b.contact_person, b.card_autorenew, b.next_tier_code, b.status as broker_status,
         (select i.reference from public.invoices_smc i where i.broker_id = c.broker_id and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_at desc limit 1) as open_ref,
         (select i.amount_excl_vat from public.invoices_smc i where i.broker_id = c.broker_id and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_at desc limit 1) as open_amount_excl_vat,
         (select i.vat_zar from public.invoices_smc i where i.broker_id = c.broker_id and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_at desc limit 1) as open_vat_zar,
         (select p.price_zar from public.pricing p where p.tier_code = coalesce(b.next_tier_code, c.tier_code)) as price_zar,
         exists (select 1 from public.cycles n where n.broker_id = c.broker_id and n.status = 'scheduled' and n.invoice_id is not null and n.cycle_id <> c.cycle_id) as next_paid
  from public.cycles c join public.brokers b on b.id = c.broker_id
  where c.status in ('active', 'extended', 'not_renewed') and c.ends_at is not null
), a as (
  select c.*, x.action from c cross join lateral (values
    (case when (c.ends_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - 7 = (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date and c.status <> 'not_renewed' then 'offer_t7' end),
    (case when (c.ends_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - 3 = (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date and not c.next_paid and c.status <> 'not_renewed' then 'remind_t3' end),
    (case when (c.ends_at at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - 1 = (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date and not c.next_paid and c.status <> 'not_renewed' then 'remind_t1' end),
    (case when c.effective_end <= now() and c.status in ('active','extended') and not c.next_paid then 'cycle_end' end),
    (case when c.status = 'not_renewed' and c.card_autorenew and (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - (c.effective_end at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date in (1, 3) then 'retry_card' end),
    (case when c.status = 'not_renewed' and (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - (c.effective_end at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date = 7 and c.broker_status = 'not_renewed' then 'come_back' end)
  ) x(action) where x.action is not null
)
select a.*, (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date - (a.effective_end at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date as days_after_end
from a where not exists (select 1 from ops.billing_actions_log l where l.cycle_id = a.cycle_id and l.action = a.action and l.day = (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date);

insert into ops.billing_actions_log (cycle_id, action, day) values ($1::uuid, $2, (now() at time zone 'Africa/Johannesburg')::date)
on conflict (cycle_id, action, day) do nothing returning cycle_id, action;

select json_build_object('progress', (select row_to_json(v) from public.v_cycle_progress v where v.cycle_id = $1::uuid),
  'quality_avg', (select round(avg(o.quality_score)::numeric, 1) from public.outcomes o where o.cycle_id = $1::uuid),
  'pricing', (select json_agg(p) from public.pricing p), 'taken', coalesce((select json_agg(reference) from public.invoices_smc where broker_id = $2::uuid and status <> 'void'), '[]'),
  'credit_cents', coalesce((select round(shortfall_credit_zar*100)::bigint from public.cycles where id = $1::uuid), 0)) as ctx;

parameters.query:
select x.broker_id, x.cycle_id, x.action, i.id, i.reference, i.total_cents, i.tier_code, i.attempts, i.email, i.billing_ref, i.authorization_code,
  (select c.media_share_zar from public.cycles c where c.id = x.cycle_id) as media_share_zar
from (select $1::uuid as broker_id, $2::uuid as cycle_id, $3::text as action) x
left join lateral (
  select i.id, i.reference, round(i.total_zar*100)::bigint as total_cents, i.tier_code, i.charge_attempts as attempts, b.email, b.billing_ref,
    public.smc_vault_paystack_auth_code(b.id) as authorization_code   -- I-33a wrapper: NULL unless card_autorenew is on
  from public.invoices_smc i join public.brokers b on b.id = i.broker_id
  where i.broker_id = x.broker_id and i.status = 'issued' order by i.issued_at desc limit 1
) i on true;

parameters.query:
SET LOCAL smc.source = 'n8n';
SET LOCAL smc.reason = 'W19 card auto-renew off (portal, broker request)';
-- The broker comes from the JWT sub only (brokers.user_id); no broker id is read from the body.
-- The update is guarded on card_autorenew = true, so a double tap changes nothing and writes one timeline row.
-- smc_vault_paystack_auth_code() returns NULL from now on, so W19 cycle end never charges the saved card.
with b as (
  select id, brand_id, current_cycle_id, paystack_subscription_code, whatsapp_number, contact_person
  from public.brokers where user_id = $1::uuid and brand_id is not null limit 1
), u as (
  update public.brokers x set card_autorenew = false from b where x.id = b.id and x.card_autorenew returning x.id
), t as (
  insert into public.lead_activities (brand_id, broker_id, cycle_id, workflow, actor_type, activity_type, payload, occurred_at, idempotency_key)
  select b.brand_id, b.id, b.current_cycle_id, 'W19', 'broker', 'card_autorenew.disabled',
    jsonb_build_object('type', 'card_autorenew.disabled', 'source', 'portal', 'had_plan', b.paystack_subscription_code is not null),
    now(), 'W19:autorenew_off:' || b.id || ':' || txid_current()
  from b join u on u.id = b.id
  returning id
)
select b.id as broker_id, exists (select 1 from u) as changed, (select count(*) from t)::int as timeline_rows,
  b.paystack_subscription_code as subscription_code, b.whatsapp_number, b.contact_person
from (select 1) one left join b on true;

parameters.content:
## W19 Cycle renewal offer
T-7: results + renewal invoice (same tier pre-selected, up/downgrade links, shortfall credit applied).
T-3, T-1: reminder with the reference in bold, only if unpaid.
Cycle end (effective end incl. 14-day extension): unpaid -> routing off + budget lowered. **No grace.** Card auto-renew (opt-in) charges here; failed -> retry day 1 and day 3 (Stripe pattern), then pay link.
Day 7 after a lapse: one "come back any time".
Idempotency: ops.billing_actions_log (cycle, action, day).
Portal POST /billing-autorenew (I-30e): broker JWT -> card_autorenew off as n8n_app, timeline row, WhatsApp confirm. Off only.
Card token read only via smc_vault_paystack_auth_code() (I-33a).
